# Acro Express

> Acro Express is a free online multiplayer acronym word game, played in the web browser at https://www.acro.express/. It is inspired by classic acro games like Acrophobia, and is an independent game.

## How it works
- Players meet at the Grand Sky Station (the lobby), chat, and board a Sky Train (a game room, up to 14 players).
- Each round (a "station") shows a topic and 3 to 7 random letters, for example B T V.
- Each player writes a phrase with one word per letter, in order: "Bring The Volcano".
- Entries are shown without names and everyone votes for their favourite.
- Points: 1 per vote received, a bonus for the winning phrase (1 point per letter), +1 for voting for the winner, and a speed bonus.
- The first player to reach 30 points wins the journey (the game).

## Features
- Sky Passport: each player's profile with stats, best acros and stamps.
- Sky Leaderboard: rankings for the week, the month and all time.
- Express Colors: colour themes named after times of the day.
- Free, no download, works on computers and phones.

## Links
- Play: https://www.acro.express/
